# ChatsenKick vX.Y.Z-kick — YYYY-MM-DD

Short one-sentence summary of this release.

## What's new

- New feature or improvement.
- Another user-visible change.

## Fixes

- Fixed an issue with chat, channels, emotes, or authorization.
- Other stability improvements.

## Download

**Android 7.0 (API 24) and newer**

Upload this APK to the release assets:

`ChatsenKick-X.Y.Z-kick-YYYY.MM.DD-HHMM-BUILD-release.apk`

SHA-256 (recommended):

```text
PASTE_APK_SHA256_HERE
```

## Installation

Download and open the APK, then allow installation from your browser or file manager if Android requests permission. Reading chat does not require an account. Kick OAuth sign-in is required to send messages.

## Verification checklist

- [ ] App installs and opens.
- [ ] Kick OAuth sign-in works.
- [ ] Messages are received and sent.
- [ ] Multiple channels can be added in one comma-separated line.
- [ ] Channel tabs and saved channels restore correctly.
- [ ] LIVE statuses load through the official Kick API.
- [ ] Emotes, replies, mentions, and media previews display correctly.
